'''Krel Thak''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. His clan was enslaved by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], but was later freed by [[Darth Malgus]]; as a result, he allied with Malgus's [[New Empire]] and was killed during the [[Battle of Ilum]].
